--api-key.help: require this key on /v1/* (Authorization: Bearer ... or x-api-key); also $STRATA_API_KEY. Several keys: separate them with commas (key1,key2), as llama.cpp does

--api-monitor.help: the API request monitor at /api-monitor: keeps the last 100 requests' prompts and answers in memory (also "api_monitor": true in the config; off by default)

--batch-groups.help: pipeline groups: auto or a positive integer, without changing the saved config

--batch-telemetry.help: opt in to low-rate engine decode-window samples for /v1/telemetry

--before-load.help: a command run before the model is loaded again (e.g. to unload another server's model; also "before_load" in the config, a string or a list)

--config.help: strata engine config (JSON: exe, args, cwd, tokenizer, model_name), written by setup.py

--fit-max-tokens.help: clamp max_tokens to the remaining context instead of rejecting the request (the default; kept so older scripts keep working)

--gpu.help: the GPU to run on, as nvidia-smi numbers them, or several for a layer split ("0,2"; also "gpu" in the config)

--host.help: the address to listen on: 127.0.0.1 = this PC only (the default), 0.0.0.0 = also other devices on your network (set an API key); also "host" in the config

--idle-unload.help: unload the model after this many seconds without requests, so other programs (games, other model servers) can use the VRAM; the next request loads it again (also "idle_unload_s" in the config; default

--lazy.help: start the API unloaded (the engine and the vision encoder start with the first request)

--max-queue.help: maximum inference calls waiting beyond effective engine slots; 0 refuses overload

--mcp-config.help: a JSON file with MCP servers in Claude Desktop's format ({"mcpServers": {...}}); the web app's chat can use their tools (also "mcp_servers" in the config)

--min-free-vram-mib.help: load an unloaded model only when this much VRAM is free, else answer 503 (also "min_free_vram_mib" in the config; default: always load)

--no-api-key.help: serve on the network without an API key (anyone who can reach the port can use the model; also "api_key": "none" in the config). Warns once, never refuses

--no-fit-max-tokens.help: answer 400 when prompt + max_tokens does not fit the context, like llama.cpp (also "fit_max_tokens": false in the config). A prompt that alone does not fit is always 400

--offline.help: do not fetch remote image URLs or start MCP/tool subprocesses

--open.help: open the local page in the browser once the model is ready

--parallel.help: request this many simultaneous engine slots without changing the saved config

--queue-timeout.help: maximum seconds waiting for the first engine turn (0.1..600; off by default)

--ready-file.help: write a JSON instance record once the API is bound and model state is known

--replicas.help: data-parallel replicas (opt-in): cut the "gpu" list into N equal groups and run one engine on each, requests spread over them (also "replicas" in the config: a number, or [{"gpus": [0, 1]}, {"gpus": [

--script.help: the mock engine's answer (default: a short greeting); given more than once, requests get them in turn and the last one repeats

--script-cycle.help: with --script given more than once: repeat the scripts by position instead of advancing to the last one and staying there, so extra requests a harness makes (a session title, a re-ask after a tool res

--script-delay.help: seconds to wait between the mock engine's tokens, so a turn stays live long enough for a client to cancel it; the mock honours cancellation between tokens

--shutdown-timeout.help: opt-in graceful drain deadline in seconds (0..300) before owned requests are cancelled

--slot-save-path.help: enable POST /slots/0?action=save|restore {"filename": NAME} (llama-server's API): the conversation the engine holds, to or from DIR/NAME (also "slot_save_path" in the config)

--tokenizer.help: pack tokenizer directory (falls back to a byte tokenizer if absent)
